description.goon_class: Robot and Organic Hybrid he is a blue magic using djinn
description.anatomy: A faceless head on a wide chested robotic torso with 4 powerful robotic arms and no humanoid elements below his ribcage, floating above the ground with a single energy thruster mounted up inside the bottom of his ribcage and emiting a blue cone(thick at top and tapering downward) of energy downward. The head is a fusion of skull and robotic elements with glowing eyes and mouth
description.armor: he has black armor plating and hyrdaulic components on articulation points. From the seams of his black metal hull blue light is being emited His overall appearance is both intimidating and skeletal, embodying the fusion of technology, darkness and magic.
description.skin: black metal plates with blue light being emitted from joints and seams
description.weapon: 4 oversized scimitars. One for each of his 4 hands.
description.setting: desert stone fortress partially in ruins with stormy skies overhead
description.time_of_day: gloomy twilight witih thunderstorm and lightning in the background
description.eyes: no eyes, just an empty surface
description.pose: holding his scimitars holding all of his scimitars at different angles in a state of readiness but not attacking, floating slightly hoveringside the fortress walls
description.boots: he is only a head torso and 4 arms. a single long blue cone of magical energy emits from the bottom of his torso to keep him aloft the wide part of the energy cone is at the top and the cone points downward tapering to a point. when he moves a long trail of blue energy follows him
